nodes.label: GATE: UDK rotate-and-still-opens
nodes.detail: HARD GATE on Monday's real onboard. Upload a file, rotate the PGP key, complete the challenge with the new key, re-wrap the data key, download again and confirm it opens. If it fails, real onboard is cancelled — a friend's data would become unreadable after their first rotation.

nodes.label: GATE: test accounts isolated
nodes.detail: Signed in as a non-admin non-test account, the test group and project are invisible AND no test handle appears in any picker, directory or autocomplete. Gate on Monday's real onboard.

nodes.label: BLOCKER: Go not installed
nodes.detail: No go binary anywhere. The committed c2panel is a prebuilt x86-64 ELF, so C2-Panel currently cannot be rebuilt or cross-compiled at all. ~150 MB install. Blocks desktop/CLI/TUI/APK work.

nodes.label: BLOCKER: no Android toolchain
nodes.detail: JRE 11 only — no javac, no gradle, no SDK, no NDK, ANDROID_HOME unset. 6-10 GB acquisition before line one. Note: Android alarms/notifications need native code a WebView cannot reach, which is why the ICS path exists instead.

nodes.label: BLOCKER: _get_infra drops edges
nodes.detail: gui/server.py::_get_infra never reads the edges array — it only rebuilds childIds (pure containment), so every typed relationship is silently dropped before /api/infra returns. This is why data FLOWS cannot be seen today, only nesting. Fix is additive and node-graph-model.md states explicitly it does not touch the bridge freeze.

nodes.label: BLOCKER: RESEND_API_KEY missing
nodes.detail: Mail send fails cleanly. Invites are links so onboarding survives, but outbound mail does not work.

Also proton-recovery-phrase.pdf sitting in the clear in ~/Downloads.
